data_sources.name: NOAA Coral Reef Watch daily global 5 km product, saved 2015/2019 summaries
NOAA/NCCOS and Analytical Laboratories of Hawaii, Main Hawaiian Islands benthic habitat mapping, 2007

displayed_layers: 51 reef-containing grid cells classed by annual maximum DHW
mapping.map_fill_meaning: Class of the whole satellite grid cell; not the extent or area of reef polygons.
mapping.habitat_area_method: Separate composition uses saved SUM_Piece_ha, not colored cell area.

limitations: Annual maximum accumulated satellite heat stress, not observed bleaching, mortality or recovery.
Historical mapped reef/hardbottom is not present-day coral cover.
No valid DHW is unavailable, not low exposure; 17.029179358495156% of all mapped reef area is unavailable.
Only reef-containing cells are class-filled; neutral cells are context, not low-exposure observations.
Grid is coarser than reef polygons; a class applies to a grid cell, not a finely resolved reef site.
No basemap, invented coastline, source imagery, external requests or NOAA endorsement.
Saved-output internal consistency does not establish raw-source reconstruction or independent scientific validation.
Neither a coastline nor actual reef polygon extent is drawn; colored cells indicate reef presence and the cell's heat class, not complete reef coverage.
display_revision: Cell classes only; historical habitat outlines omitted as an unnecessary heavy display layer.
